title: DEPHYRIER Empat Puluh Delapan (Name The Denominator)
style: denominator pulse 102 bpm trilingual EN ID FR DEPHYRIER signature floating-denominator roster-needed minimal-kick spoken-indonesian ledger-tone
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Forty two of forty eight running clean it claimed
Forty seven of forty eight registrar named
Forty eight of forty eight nowhere to be found
The denominator floats on no actual ground

[Pre-Chorus — Indonesian]
Empat puluh delapan dari mana datangnya
(Forty-eight where does it come from)
Denominator tanpa daftar adalah dongeng saja
(Denominator without list is only a fairy tale)

[Chorus — Trilingual]
DEPHYRIER forty eight prove the denominator
Empat puluh delapan dari sumber jelas
(Forty-eight from a clear source)
Quarante huit prouve le dénominateur
(Forty-eight prove the denominator)

[Verse 2]
Forty two clean forty seven billed forty eight planned
Three numbers floating without the same hand
A matrix needs a roster a roster needs a row
Without the row the count is just for show

[Bridge — French]
Le dénominateur sans liste est un décor
(The denominator without list is a backdrop)
Nomme les sites ou le chiffre s'endort
(Name the sites or the number falls asleep)

[Outro — Trilingual]
DEPHYRIER forty eight name the list
Empat puluh delapan tanpa daftar tidak
DEPHYRIER quarante huit la liste ou rien
